content.text: Redis Pub/Sub allows publishers to send messages to channels without knowing who (if anyone) is subscribed. Subscribers receive messages in real time.

content.code:
# Subscriber (blocks waiting for messages)
SUBSCRIBE notifications

# Publisher (in a different connection)
PUBLISH notifications "New order placed: #1234"

# Pattern subscribe
PSUBSCRIBE orders.*

content.text: Pub/Sub messages are fire-and-forget — if no subscriber is connected, the message is lost. Use Streams for durability.

questions.question: What happens to a Pub/Sub message if no subscriber is listening?
options: It is stored in a list
questions.explanation: Redis Pub/Sub is fire-and-forget; messages not received by a subscriber at the moment of publish are lost.

faq.q: Can I use Pub/Sub for a chat app?
faq.a: Yes for simple cases. For message history or offline delivery, use Redis Streams instead, which persist messages.
